messages:
anna: Heads up — deploybot scheduled soft-unpin for runtime-3.2 in eu-west tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Requesting SDK + quant owners to ack. Affects models: gptx-mini-q, llama2q-prod.

deploybot: [auto] Proposed action: soft-unpin runtime-3.2 -> fallback to runtime-3.1 if kernel mismatch. Window: 2026-11-12T02:00:00Z. Affected routes: /v1/generate (eu-west). Pinlist excerpt:
```
runtime_pins: {\"runtime-3.2\": \"soft-unpin\"}
exceptions: [\"internal-eval\", \"nightly-qa\"]
```

mike: @anna noted. Are embeddings impacted? we have a high-volume job hitting gptx-mini-q.

pradeep: recommend hold. quant tests show divergence at longseq > 1k tokens on runtime-3.2 for gptx-mini-q. Need a quick smoke run against canary.

sylvie: I'll add a short blurb to release notes and ops runbook. What should we say about fallback behavior? @deploybot

deploybot: fallback behavior: requests will be routed to most-compatible runtime variant; token billing unchanged; if model not compatible, 429 will trigger and clients see `retryable: true` header. Can add `x-fallback-runtime` header in responses during window.

anna: plan: hold until canary smoke by 21:30 UTC today. If passes, proceed with soft-unpin; else rollback scheduled to 03:30 UTC. @pradeep @mike can you run smoke by then?

mike: Starting now. will post results in this thread. :eyes:

pradeep: On it. will run longseq stress + sample evalset. If divergence > 1% we'll veto.

oncall-bot: deploybot reported no active incidents. Canary cluster eu-west/canary-2 ready. Logs: http://internal/logs/4555554321

mike: smoke run done. no OOMs, latency +2ms p95, samples ok. attaching summary.

pradeep: stress run done. divergence at 0.4% on longseq, within threshold. Approving soft-unpin proceeding. :thumbsup:

anna: cool — proceeding with scheduled soft-unpin. I'll update release notes and ping support. Thanks team.
